    Lemma 2.9: vanishing on modules killed by e #

    lem:projective-evaluation-criterion: "Assume Hom_Λ(T, Λ) = Ext¹_Λ(T, Λ) = 0 whenever Te = 0. … It suffices to check the two vanishings on the simple Λ-modules killed by e. … composition series and the long exact sequences extend the two vanishings from the simples to every module killed by e." In the proof of Proposition 2.10 the simples killed by e are the tops L_x at nonprojective labels, where the vanishings come from the exact right meshes (MeshData.hom_top_eq_zero, MeshData.extend_top).

    Here e is the sum of the idempotents at the projective labels; a module is killed by e when every projective idempotent acts by zero. Ext¹ = 0 is used in extension form: maps into R_w extend from a submodule with quotient killed by e.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
